name: Agent Polkit
cmd: sh -c '/usr/bin/pgrep -x hyprpolkitagent >/dev/null && exit 0; for agent in /usr/lib/hyprpolkitagent/hyprpolkitagent /usr/libexec/hyprpolkitagent /usr/lib/lxqt-policykit-agent /usr/libexec/lxqt-policykit-agent /usr/lib/polkit-kde-authentication-agent-1; do if [ -x "$agent" ]; then exec "$agent"; fi; done' &

name: Historique du presse-papiers
cmd: sh -c '/usr/bin/pgrep -f "cliphist store" >/dev/null || exec wl-paste --watch cliphist store'
